title: Eighteenmile 2023 measured chlorophyll and observed-flow context
source_notes: Original CHLA units, depth, laboratory activity IDs and declared timezones are retained.
Flow windows exclude the sampling date. Every daily source-record index is retained in plot-data.csv and study_flow_dates.csv.
Numerical quantities are plotted directly without censor substitution or concentration-to-load conversion.

figures.title: Measured chlorophyll across the Eighteenmile lake arm
figures.caption: Five original stations, fifteen reconciled CHLA surface samples per station, sampled 5 April–17 October 2023 at 0.3 m. Common 0–40 ug/L scales permit comparison. Lines connect sampled dates; all points retain original activity IDs, values, dates and declared timezones. Two same-date routine-clock overlaps are explicitly excluded from the selected cohort and retained in the complete measurement table. Printed Table 7 n = 4 at SV-374 and SV-840 is retained separately from the fifteen original observations at each station.

figures.title: Observed station distributions
figures.caption: All 75 original selected values are shown. Boxes span the 25th–75th percentiles, with R-7 linear interpolation; center lines show medians; whiskers show observed minima and maxima; diamonds show arithmetic means. Horizontal point offsets separate observations and do not encode another variable.

figures.title: Original laboratory dates and preceding upstream flow
figures.caption: Daily mean discharge at upstream USGS 02186702 on fifteen chlorophyll dates and the additional 24 August microcystin date. Dashed series gives the highest observed daily mean during the preceding seven calendar days, excluding the laboratory date. Each window contains seven observations. The 134.8 ft3/s reference is the 95th percentile of all 365 observed 2023 daily means. The gauge supplies upstream context; these are not measured discharges at the lake stations.

figures.title: Chlorophyll and preceding upstream-flow context
figures.caption: The same 75 original lake observations are plotted against their shared preceding-seven-day maximum daily mean at upstream USGS 02186702. Filled points followed at least one daily mean at or above the 2023 95th percentile. All five panels use common scales. The points describe source-bound temporal context; no fitted regression or causal attribution is applied.
